title: Broncos LB Jonathon Cooper pleads not guilty to assault, trial set for November

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Broncos LB Jonathon Cooper pleads not guilty to assault, trial set for November
sources.description: Broncos linebacker Jonathon Cooper was put on paid leave over the weekend due to his domestic violence arrest this offseason and he was in a Colorado courtroom for a hearing on those charges Monday.
